name: Bitumen
overview: Scripture reveals bitumen as an inflammable mineral substance used practically in ancient times, notably for construction and preservation. In Genesis 11:3, it is described as 'slime' used as mortar in brick-making, highlighting human ingenuity in building. Genesis 14:10 depicts the vale of Siddim as filled with slimepits, indicating natural bitumen deposits in the environment. In Exodus 2:3, bitumen (referred to as slime and pitch) was employed to waterproof the ark that preserved the infant Moses, symbolizing God's providential protection. These verses collectively show bitumen's practical role in God’s providential design for human survival and preservation.
